_README: Per-machine orchestrator config. Command templates below are the ONLY place the exact agy/codex invocation lives. Tokens substituted at runtime: {PROMPT} (composed prompt, inlined as one argv), {OUTPUT_FILE} (path the CLI should write its final JSON to), {SCHEMA_FILE} (JSON Schema for the phase's contract), {CWD} (repo root). A command containing '*' is glob-resolved to the newest match (handles Codex's versioned bin path). Env overrides: RESEARCH_BACKEND, RESEARCH_CONCURRENCY, RESEARCH_TARGET_COUNT, RESEARCH_MAX_FOLLOWUPS, RESEARCH_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS, CODEX_BIN, AGY_BIN.

antigravity._note: Antigravity CLI (`agy`, the Go binary — separate from the Antigravity IDE). Headless research call: `agy -p "<prompt>" --output-format json --json-schema <file>` — returns candidates in the envelope's `structured_output`. agy is RESEARCH-ONLY here: it writes no files (the orchestrator persists inbox artifacts) and runs with cwd=research/ + a dedicated homeDir so the global agy config is untouched. Google auth is in Windows Credential Manager (`gemini:antigravity`); `research:doctor` verifies presence. Install: `irm https://antigravity.google/cli/install.ps1 | iex` or `winget install Google.AntigravityCLI`, then sign in once with `agy`.

codex._note: Codex CLI batch curator. Headless call: `codex exec --json -o <file>` writes the agent's final message (the batch-verdict JSON) to the -o file. `codex exec` has NO `-a/--ask-for-approval` flag (approval is implicit non-interactive). Bare "codex" is auto-resolved on Windows to %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenAI\Codex\bin\<version>\codex.exe (newest); set CODEX_BIN to override. Auth via `codex login`; `research:doctor` checks it.
codex._safety: sandbox=workspace-write lets the curator write research/ files. It technically permits writing elsewhere in the repo — the meta prompt forbids touching production Spot data; verify with `git status` after real runs. Tighten with an execpolicy .rules file if needed.
